lines.text: Brand new full bathroom remodels, starting at just $14,995.
Most homeowners think a full bathroom remodel has to cost thirty thousand dollars.
This is the whole bathroom, start to finish, taken down and built back new.
That is why it starts at $14,995, instead of the thirty thousand most companies will quote you for the exact same bathroom.
We take out the old bathroom and haul it away.
We put in a brand new shower or bathtub and waterproof it properly.
You get new wall surrounds, and you choose how they are finished, tile or acrylic, whichever you want.
You also get a brand new glass shower door, a new vanity, a new toilet, new flooring, and all new fixtures.
Labor and materials are both included.
The final price depends on the size of your bathroom and the materials you choose, and you get an honest number before we start.
At Luxury Home Renovations, we are a licensed bathroom remodeling contractor with 38 years of experience, licensed in both Tennessee and Georgia.
Our own crews do the work, not subcontractors, including the electrical and the plumbing.
And you pick your materials in person in our own showroom.
Your work is backed by a two year labor warranty, plus the full manufacturer warranties on your materials.
Click "Get Quote" to book your free design consultation.
